description: This source file defines CLI commands related to node management in a control plane application. Specifically, it includes a command for registering serverless agents via an HTTP POST request to a specified endpoint. The code utilizes the Cobra library for CLI command structuring and performs network operations, JSON encoding/decoding, and environment variable handling.

methods.name: NewNodesCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns a new 'nodes' command for managing agent nodes, including subcommands such as register-serverless.

methods.name: newRegisterServerlessCommand
methods.description: Constructs the 'register-serverless' subcommand which registers a serverless agent by invoking an API with provided URL and token, handling JSON responses.
